figure: Figure 1 (A4): a, Threadfin concept; b, algorithm pipeline, fidelity test, biological inference
panel_b_title: Threadfin integrates scRNA-seq and BCR data into clone embeddings to infer relationships between clones

Algorithm pipeline: 1 scRNA-seq states / scBCR clone links on the same cells
2 overlapping clones pooled into Frechet means
3 clone embedding: points at Frechet means; A and A' share a footprint and sit together; cells of the two right arms interleave evenly on the scRNA UMAP
Clone embedding fidelity test: 4 observed clonal ICC vs 500 clone-label shuffles within samples
Biological inference: 5 GC B and plasma cells: one mass on the scRNA UMAP; their clones form a continuous GC hub with two parallel, unlabelled branches in the clone embedding (coloured GC-like to plasma-like)
6 position along the clone embedding tracks antigen binding and fate mapping

scope: Schematic; synthetic cells, clones, embeddings, statistics and readouts
not_used: Clonotrace density surfaces, kNN-graph diffusion and optimal-transport distance matrix
